clips.title: The story
paras: Bazil Thredd is Edwin VanCleef's lieutenant and most trusted assistant, locked in the Stormwind Stockade since the Stonemasons' riots. Now the prison has risen in revolt, and Thredd leads the rioting Defias inmates from its eastern cell block.

When the Stonemasons Guild was refused payment by the nobility of Stormwind for rebuilding the city, Edwin VanCleef rejected government appeasements and sparked open revolt. Bazil Thredd stood at VanCleef's side as his chief lieutenant and most trusted assistant. During the violent clashes that followed, Thredd was captured by the city guard. While VanCleef and the surviving masons fled into Westfall to form the Defias Brotherhood, Thredd was cast into the depths of the Stormwind Stockade.

For years, Thredd remained silent and seemingly forsaken behind iron bars. That isolation shattered with a massive prison riot that overran the guards, opening the cells and turning the Stockade into an armed fortress right under the Mage Quarter. Taking leadership of the imprisoned Defias bandits, insurgents, and allied cutthroats, Thredd established his command post in the eastern wing under the guard of an ogre named Hamhock. Warden Thelwater, desperate to restore order before the chaos spills into the city streets, demands Thredd's head to break the rebellion's leadership.
